column1: # Reviewed Greek interlinear card data — pilot: John 6:50-51 (Byzantine / Robinson-Pierpont).
# Editable source of truth for data/reviewed-greek-gloss.{json,js}.
#   book chapter verse token surface strongs morphology transliteration gloss status source_note
# token is 1-based and must match the token order in data/byz-interlinear.json.
# surface / strongs / morphology must byte-match the Byzantine token after NFC normalization;
#   the build script refuses to run otherwise.
#         "reviewed-pilot-blank"  -> gloss must be empty (intentional no-gloss; NOT missing data)
# A token with no row at all is "missing" (runtime falls back to the Strong's-derived gloss).
# Transliteration: macrons for eta/omega (ē/ō), dropped accents/breathings except rough breathing.
# English glosses reviewed for context; not copied positionally from any other edition.
